title: Income Tax: changes resulting from new savings and property rates
text:
This measure makes 6 amendments to tax legislation following the Budget 2025 announcement that the savings basic rate of Income Tax will increase from 6 April 2027 and that separate tax rates for property income will be introduced from the same date.

 It makes sure that the rules on insurers’ reporting, tax treated as paid on gains from certain foreign life insurance policies, deduction at source, calculations of trustees’ tax pools, and the Transfer of Assets Abroad legislation continue to operate as intended from 6 April 2027.
changeNote: Details on how property and savings income will count towards trustees’ tax pools from 6 April 2027 have been added.
